first_error_evidence: Agent typed 'q' as a shell command believing it was still in a git diff pager (less), despite having already returned to the shell and successfully created the stanford-update branch at step 7.
verification_evidence: Step 19: git status shows 'nothing to commit, working tree clean' after merge. Step 20: head -3 _includes/about.md confirms 'I am a Postdoctoral Researcher at Stanford CS.' is present on master.
one_sentence_strategy_summary: The agent correctly identified the lost changes in a detached HEAD commit via git reflog, created a recovery branch, and merged it into master after resolving a content conflict, despite a brief detour from pager confusion and a redundant branch creation step.
